description: Defines functions and types for directory listing operations in the Starboard platform, including opening, closing, and iterating over directory entries.

methods.name: SbDirectoryOpen
methods.description: Opens an existing directory for listing; deprecated in SB_API_VERSION 16.

methods.name: SbDirectoryClose
methods.description: Closes an open directory stream handle; deprecated in SB_API_VERSION 16.

methods.name: SbDirectoryGetNext
methods.description: Retrieves the next entry in the directory stream; deprecated in SB_API_VERSION 16.

methods.name: SbDirectoryCanOpen
methods.description: Checks if a directory can be opened; available only if SB_API_VERSION < 16.

methods.name: SbDirectoryCreate
methods.description: Creates a directory; available only if SB_API_VERSION < 16.
